Question: What type, location, and status are recorded for asset CAP-001?

rank_trace.sql:
SELECT at.type_name, l.location_name, a.status  
   FROM assets a  
   JOIN asset_types at ON a.asset_type_id = at.asset_type_id  
   JOIN locations l ON a.location_id = l.location_id  
   WHERE a.asset_name = 'CAP-001';

SELECT at.type_name, l.location_name, a.status  
   FROM assets a  
   JOIN asset_types at ON a.asset_type_id = at.asset_type_id  
   JOIN locations l ON a.location_id = l.location_id  
   JOIN work_orders wo ON wo.asset_id = a.asset_id  
   WHERE a.asset_name = 'CAP-001' AND wo.fault_code = 'CAP';

SELECT at.type_name, l.location_name, a.status

   JOIN locations l ON a.location_id = l.location_id  
   JOIN sensor_readings sr ON sr.asset_id = a.asset_id  
   WHERE a.asset_name = 'CAP-001';
